neighbours.label: The subword piece 'ac' / 'AC' as its own token at the end or middle of a word ('Bor|ac|ay', 'HU|AC', 'Y|AC', 'd|iac|ritical'); not the letters 'ac' inside other tokens or at a word start
fire: The clinic prescribed Prozac after the second appointment.
Our old furnace was replaced by a modern HVAC unit last winter.
The children were taken to the cardiac ward for tests.
Her grandfather had worked on the ENIAC project in the forties.
They sailed past the cliffs of Carnac in the morning fog.
The committee known as HUAC questioned dozens of screenwriters.
He read a few pages of Balzac before falling asleep.
The geneticists stored the fragments in BAC and YAC libraries.
quiet: The clinic prescribed aspirin after the second appointment.
Our old furnace was replaced by a modern heating unit last winter.
The children were taken to the heart ward for tests.
Her grandfather had worked on the radar project in the forties.
They sailed past the cliffs of Dover in the morning fog.
The committee took action and questioned dozens of actors.
He read a few pages of Flaubert before falling asleep.
The geneticists stored the fragments in accurate and accessible libraries.

notes: Card: 'ac' x14, 'AC' x9, 'iac' x3. Probes: Boracay 0.85, HUAC 0.72, YAC 0.88, diacritical 0.59; 'actions account' 0.003. Fire words chosen in the hope that the tokenizer splits off 'ac' / 'AC'; I could not check the split of the new words without scoring them. Trigger declared as pieces.
